title: Multi-key blocking wait: one waiter queued on every key, FIFO wake and hand-off
description: Register one waiter (own tokio Notify + woken flag) at the back of the FIFO of every key before the last emptiness check; pushes wake the oldest not-yet-woken waiters of the key after releasing the shard lock; the waiter clears its flag under the registry lock before each attempt; leaving (pop, timeout, cancel via Drop) dequeues first, then wakes the next waiter of each key that still holds data. Fixes sequential per-key waits and the check-then-subscribe lost wake-up. Test with a test-held gate lock passed as the guarded pop's lock.
whenToUse: Wait-for-any-of-several-keys-then-take APIs where the waiter performs the take itself.
whenNotToUse: Producers that can hand the item to the waiter directly under one lock.
